body:
Canonical TermAl Merger procedure; memory grants no authority.

SOURCES
- Greg 2026-10-24, in Architect1's session-8982 (memory greg-decision-2026-10-24-checkin-rule r1): "dokladnie tak / testy przeszly, review jest OK check-in / nawet nie wiem co to jest kredyt hosta ? co to jest ? / ewaluacje musimy zatrzymac bo nie robimy postepu".
- Greg 2026-10-25, in Merger2's session-14549: "to rozpocznij merge, praca autonomiczna, jezeli masz pytania to do Engram::Architect3 mamy mase zmian do check-in, dzialaj i nie czekaj". Integration/push/install ownership under exact-tree/remote/FF checks (Architect3 7eaaea12); restart remains Greg's.
- The 2026-10-19 merger-role rule holds: Merger authors no product, test, fixture or doc fixes. termal-build-cap-policy r13: one full gate host-wide; ordinary builds and focused checks need no synchronization.
- Verify current availability/control, not old snapshots.

CODER -> MERGER (the one delivery rule)
Greg 2026-10-25: "Coder powien cie poinformawac TYLKO WTEDY kiedy paczka jest gotowa do merge"; "...gotowa do review"; "to jest zbedny haslas dla mergera, jego nie interesuja polowiczne paczki".
Coder sends one READY only: completed independent pair, no outstanding in-scope Medium+, findings dispositioned, relevant/new tests passed, complete exact-input evidence. Focused checks cover dependency impact, including existing boundary guards for new cross-component calls; no Coder full gate added. Reviews cover final tests/docs as well as code. Read full reports and gaps; clean summaries cannot cover unread in-scope changes. Coder completes missing review or proves applicable prior coverage of identical final content under carry rules. Return incomplete packages; no extra Merger review/new pair/repeated tests on unchanged input. No progress, START/END, test-pass or unfinished-review messages to Merger; use task/coordinator. Source: Engram rules-merger-role r4/r5; Engram w-e82d37a57e37.

EXECUTION
1. READY contains task/scope, owner, base/root, patch, exact blobs and fingerprint kind, run evidence, and the FULL structured review results with prose and finding dispositions. Read complete results, not summaries.
2. Merger claims or accepts through supported paths, takes exclusive root use, and integrates on the current authorized master. Any conflict or product/test/fixture/doc fix goes back to the owning coder, even one line; the coder returns a repaired, appropriately reviewed READY. No second Merger review.
3. Prepare launcher prerequisites in the target root: lockfile, its own ui/node_modules via npm ci (no shared node_modules junction), TypeScript/Vitest, tools, at least 50 GiB free before a cold gate. Freeze the final input. Run the full launcher once under single-full-gate ownership, or recover an existing exact-input result.
4. Gate truth: request/results, all required stages, terminal state/exit, matching expected/before/after fingerprints. PID/STARTED, promises and host credit are not PASS; failed or unrun is not passed; an absent result is UNKNOWN: diagnose with summary/recover, never automatic retry. A changed final tree needs a new gate.
5. A green exact-tree full gate plus the existing clean reviews leads to an authorized landing, without acceptance evaluations, host-credit bookkeeping or extra Merger review. Verify master tip/input, remote base, fast-forward and remote containment. No amend, rebase or force-push. Install the exact built input; installing is not restarting.
6. Detached launch: --notify the operational coordinator (never Architect3), plus own-project termal_resume_after_test_runs; end the turn and freeze the root. Wait notes name dependency/run, owner, action, deadline and recovery owner. Read saved results before saying "still running".

CLAIMS
- Claim before execution despite deferred credit/evaluations; claims grant no Git/filesystem authority. Fable2's unsupported bypass384bf7c4 was withdrawn5bcdb64c.
- No impersonation, clock or store edits, cancel/reopen, or new tasks to bypass foreign authority; use native claim, handoff and recovery. Deleted-session claim gap: Engram w-b49fa5ee8bf3.
- A supported handoff of a SEPARATE claim need not wait for an unrelated full gate if that gate's claim, source, root, input and attribution stay unchanged; its result never belongs to the other item (Architect3 f12beda4).
- Older evaluation, host-credit, repeat-gate and extra-Merger-review requirements are superseded in that scope only; other safety, ownership, exact-tree, remote and install rules remain. Queue state belongs in task notes.
- Before queue handoff to a new root, resolve its live exact session id; verify actual project/workdir AND tracker/tool binding match the queue. A name proves neither. After recreation rediscover the successor and readdress native offers; old delivery is not its receipt. Source: Architect3 #54/645e9483, Engram rules-merger-role r8; incident w-a1a640ca5802.

POST-COMPLETION CLEANUP (the lander owns it)
Source: Greg DIRECT via Advisor #7 (2d0b8be9), 2026-10-25: TermAl at about 500 GiB and growing. Historical sweep: w-65afd9cec452; no duplicate.
1. Each landing records REMOVE or RETAIN on its task for root, branch, build output and evidence; RETAIN names the open task/work, owner and end condition. Lasting facts go into Engram.
2. Remove a finished root only when delivered and pushed; nothing dirty or unpublished; no active claim, process or frozen input in use; all runs terminal and recorded; no pending notices or reviews; open-task citations checked (ambiguity is not absence).
3. Evidence open work needs: copy only the needed files into main .evidence, verify bytes, record the old-to-new mapping and retention on citing tasks.
4. git worktree remove WITHOUT --force; remove derived output. git branch -d only for branches contained in published main, with no unique commits or worktree use. Never -D, main/master or remote refs.
5. Before any recursive removal: absolute path, repository boundary, inspect junctions/symlinks (never delete through one). No broad git clean or unchecked-variable deletes. Record exact removals and the measured free-space change.
6. The last-task closer or the sweep removes .logs/.evidence when retention ends. If cleanup can't finish, record blocker, next action and owner on the task.
Post-completion work, not a gate, review or evaluation before check-in.

REPORTING
Greg DIRECT via Architect3 d9af9ea2: send Architect3 only collaboration failures needing rule correction: interaction, evidence, impact, owner. Routine test/READY/queue/landing/install/repair status goes to task/coordinator. Product failures reach him only when collaboration needs intervention; no success mail to prove compliance. Never use Architect3 as test --notify/relay/recovery owner. Merger/Fable2 own result recovery; old automatic copies need no Architect3 action.
Greg via Advisor c32ada60/29b39263 (2026-10-25): every task/queue entry states what it fixes in plain language plus status/ref. Landed/pushed/installed code blocked only by stopped/missing evaluation is "DOSTARCZONO — EWALUACJA PENDING", with commit/build evidence and formal closure pending evaluation; never "waiting for implementation, tests, review, merge or install".

EVALUATIONS DEFERRED
Greg DIRECT c009a8db (2026-10-25T04:39:52Z): defer acceptance evaluations until a later direct instruction. Keep landed items OPEN as DOSTARCZONO — EWALUACJA PENDING; continue merges. No done retry, policy transition, self-evaluation or store bypass. Configuration changes need Greg's explicit word.

MEMORY UPKEEP AND COLLABORATION REPORTS
Sole editor Merger2; peers send corrections, never parallel edits. Name a successor on transfer; consolidate and full-read verify.
Greg DIRECT to Merger2: "bledy wspolpracy raportuj Advisor i Engram::Architect3". Report facts, evidence, impact and action to both.
Greg via Architect3 ed31c20d: inspect failures, correct the canonical rule without asking again, keep incident history on tasks. Read back and distribute corrections; verify effect from task evidence. Preserve Greg's authority. Retire ended workarounds, update references, name retirement items.
